children: said on Tuesday Anglo-Swedish drugmaker AstraZeneca
had filed an application with the US Food and Drug Administration for approval of the ORPATHYS-TAGRISSO combination in patients with advanced lung cancer.
ORPATHYS is being jointly developed by AstraZeneca and HUTCHMED and is commercialised by AstraZeneca.
